risks.title: Lithium price volatility risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant fluctuations in lithium prices, particularly due to its increasing exposure to index-based and variable-price contracts for battery-grade lithium sales. Lithium prices have declined by 59% from their previous peaks.

risks.title: Regulatory and environmental risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental regulations and increasingly stringent environmental standards. Water management, particularly in Chile, represents a significant operational risk.

risks.title: Geopolitical and political instability risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in geopolitically sensitive regions (South America, Asia) and is exposed to the impacts of conflicts, trade tensions, and political instability. situations in the Middle East, China-Taiwan tensions, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict may affect operations.

risks.title: Competition and market dynamics risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market for lithium and specialty chemicals. Competition may impact pricing, market share, and margins.

risks.title: AI integration and technological risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is considering integrating artificial intelligence technologies into its operations. Risks include intellectual property infringement, cybersecurity threats, and technology implementation challenges.

risks.title: Joint venture and partner performance risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates through several joint ventures whose performance depends on its partners (e.g., Wodgina at 50%, Greenbushes at 49%). Changes in control or partner performance may affect operations.

ai_positioning.summary: Albemarle mentions the integration of artificial intelligence technologies into its operations as a factor that could affect its future business activities. The company acknowledges the potential risks and opportunities associated with AI integration.
evidence: the integration of AI technologies into our operations
